decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen is the firm's award-winning flagship, repeatedly honoured with gold by the Deutsches Brotinstitut, so it anchors the seasonal business.
Unlike the other new breads that were removed, the dark malt rye bread survived the 2024 range cleanup and still has its own page, which suggests steady demand from regular customers.
The marzipan stollen is a classic seasonal item that complements the flagship stollen, stays on its own page and is cheap to keep in a handcraft bakery's Christmas range.
